descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S14 「一个药走过它的各个状态：active → held → 有条件的重新开始 → 重新开始 → stopped → 刷新」 One drug through its states: active → held → conditional restart → restarted → stopped → reload

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status.（UAT TC-19 ER 2；TFA-92597 R1）
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date.（UAT TC-19 ER 5；UAT TC-19 ER 10；TFA-92597 R6）
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated.（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 R5）
  • T4 A restarted or resumed medication no longer shows stale 'held' language, on the tracker or in the note.（TFA-94655 AC 3）
  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on …（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 What；TFA-92597 AC 3）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient; pre-round Save Note seeds lisinopril and metoprolol; live models

When Four Save & Extracts, each replacing the whole encounter text; a checkpoint on Post-Round → meds after each; then reload and open the Pre-Round Medications panel

Then cp1 lisinopril Held · today 'BP soft'. cp2 still held, no 'tomorrow' or '110' in the reason, no Started. cp3 active with Started · today and no Held tag. cp4 Stopped · today with 'cough'. cp5 after reload the same, and the Pre-Round panel shows lisinopril discontinued with 'cough'. Exactly one lisinopril row at every checkpoint. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Same-day saves, so re-dating is caught by the reason text, not the date ('day 1 only' under U18). 'Exactly one lisinopril row' and 'no tag on metoprolol' are in spec.manual and rowChecks until oracle.mjs has count and row-scoped checks. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U35；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
